Title: Suresh's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Suresh - 36 years, prince, son
Look: turban, blue angarkha, a sash
2. Hema - 57 years, queen, mother
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress
3. Pallavi - 35 years, friend
Look: green saree
4. Nitin - 47 years, general
Look: iron armour, red turban
5. Shalini - 31 years, princess, daughter
Look: golden jewellery, green royal dress

Places

1. The training ground - an earth ground, a rack of weapons
2. The village well - a stone well, a rope and a bucket
3. The battlefield - tents, flags, dust

Scene 1: The training ground - Day

[Suresh stands on the training ground. Hema and Pallavi stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Let's do something fun today."

[Suresh practises sword fighting.]

Suresh: "Okay."

[Suresh mounts his horse and gallops away.]

Hema: "Really?"

[Suresh shoots an arrow from his galloping horse.]

Hema: "That was fun!"

Scene 2: The village well - Day

Pallavi: "Nitin, look over here."

[Suresh drinks water from his cupped hands.]

Nitin: "Really?"

[Suresh grinds wheat on the stone hand-mill.]

Suresh: "That's easy."

[Suresh churns butter in the earthen pot.]

Nitin: "How beautiful!"

Scene 3: The battlefield - Day

[Suresh stands on the battlefield. Hema, Nitin and Shalini stand near him.]

Suresh: "Mother, look over here."

[Suresh dies of his sword wound on the battlefield.]

Nitin (excited): "We have to be strong now."
